# `ptfkit.bruand1994`

```cpp
import ptfkit.bruand1994;
```

**Exported namespace:** `ptfkit::bruand1994`

Bruand et al. water-retention relationships for clayey soils with similar clay fabrics.

## Source

Bruand, A., Baize, D., & Hardy, M. (1994). Prediction of water retention properties of clayey soils: Validity of relationships using a single soil characteristic. Soil Use and Management, 10(3), 99-103.

[DOI: 10.1111/j.1475-2743.1994.tb00467.x](https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1475-2743.1994.tb00467.x)

## Scope

**Territory:** South-eastern Paris Basin, France

**Dataset:** Validation measurements from 20 non-calcareous clayey Bt horizons of terres d'Aubues developed in a loamy clay formation derived from Jurassic limestone.

[PTF catalog page](../../../ptf-catalog/sources/bruand1994.md)

## Functions

### `calc_ptf_bruand1994_clay_water_retention` {#function-calc_ptf_bruand1994_clay_water_retention}

Estimate mass-specific water retention at -30 and -1500 kPa from clay content.

```cpp
[[nodiscard]]
inline Bruand1994ClayWaterContents calc_ptf_bruand1994_clay_water_retention(double clay_content)
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `clay_content` | Clay content by dry mass for particles smaller than 2 micrometres; the domain is the range in the 20-horizon validation dataset. (%) |

#### Returns

A `Bruand1994ClayWaterContents` value.

!!! note

    These are two point predictions, not a continuous water-retention curve.

!!! note

    Apply the equations only to clayey horizons with clay fabric similar to the source soils, as required by the article.

!!! warning

    The structured clay-content domain records the validation dataset range, not a general physical limit or permission to ignore clay fabric.

### `calc_ptf_bruand1994_bulk_volume_water_retention` {#function-calc_ptf_bruand1994_bulk_volume_water_retention}

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |

| `bulk_volume` | Field bulk volume of moist clods per dry-soil mass; the domain spans the values listed in Table 1. (cm^3/g) |

#### Returns

A `Bruand1994BulkVolumeWaterContents` value.

!!! note

    These are two point predictions, not a continuous water-retention curve.

!!! note

    Apply the equations only to clayey horizons with clay fabric similar to the source soils, as required by the article.

!!! warning

    The article prose gives 0.679 cm^3/g as the minimum measured bulk volume, but Table 1 includes 0.657 cm^3/g for horizon 15. The structured domain preserves the complete tabulated range.

### `calc_ptf_bruand1994_clay_available_water` {#function-calc_ptf_bruand1994_clay_available_water}

Estimate volumetric available water capacity from clay content.

```cpp
[[nodiscard]]
inline double calc_ptf_bruand1994_clay_available_water(double clay_content)
```

#### Parameters

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `clay_content` | Clay content by dry mass for particles smaller than 2 micrometres; the domain is the range in the 20-horizon validation dataset. (%) |

#### Returns

Difference between calculated volumetric water contents at -30 and -1500 kPa matric potential. (cm^3/cm^3)

!!! note

    Equation 16 combines the clay-based mass-specific retention equations with the clay-to-bulk-volume regression in equation 12.

!!! note

    Apply the equation only to clayey horizons with clay fabric similar to the source soils, as required by the article.

!!! warning

    The structured clay-content domain records the validation dataset range, not a general physical limit or permission to ignore clay fabric.
